notes.drawing: The restroom door sign: a man (head, rounded torso, two legs) and a woman (head, dress, two legs) either side of a divider. Heads radius 18, every gap 16 units in regular. Phosphor's toilet already covers the fixture, so this is only the sign.
notes.gendered: Phosphor's maintainer wrote in the request that they "don't love how this icon is gendered" and put it in the backlog (phosphorPlanned). The neutral version is wc, shipped beside this one; restroom is the sign people asked for and the one on most doors.
